name: Stormwind Nougat
summary: Stormwind Nougat is a festive holiday confection handed out during Hallow's End by the innkeeper of Stormwind. Travelers who perform a display of strength can claim a piece to share with young orphans eager for a taste of the celebration.

sections.title: A Festive Stormwind Sweet
sections.body: During the autumn celebration of Hallow's End, the capital cities of the Alliance participate in time-honored trick-or-treating traditions. In the city of Stormwind, the innkeeper keeps a ready supply of chewy Stormwind Nougat to distribute to revelers. However, getting a piece requires indulging the spirit of the holiday: anyone seeking the sweet must first strike an impressive pose and flex their muscles on command. The treat represents the hearty, resilient character of the human capital, offering a chewy reward to those willing to play along.

sections.title: Treats for an Orphan
sections.body: While adventurers freely crisscross Azeroth during the festival, not everyone in Stormwind is able to wander the streets. Jesper, a young orphan under the watchful care of Matron Nightingale, is kept safely near the city gates and cannot partake in the merriment himself. Sympathetic champions who gather Stormwind Nougat alongside traditional treats from Ironforge, Darnassus, and Gnomeregan can bring the collection to Jesper so that he does not miss out on the joy of Hallow's End.

faq.q: How do you get Stormwind Nougat?
faq.answer: You can obtain Stormwind Nougat by speaking with the innkeeper in Stormwind during Hallow's End. The innkeeper will ask you to perform a trick—specifically flexing your muscles—before handing over the sweet.

faq.q: What is Stormwind Nougat used for?
faq.answer: The nougat is primarily collected as part of the holiday task to gather four different Alliance treats for Jesper, an orphan boy standing outside Stormwind who cannot go trick-or-treating himself.

A human orphan named Jesper wants the nougat, along with confections from Ironforge, Darnassus, and Gnomeregan. Because he is confined to the orphanage grounds by Matron Nightingale, he relies on friendly travelers to trick-or-treat on his behalf.

faq.q: Can Horde players obtain Stormwind Nougat?
faq.answer: No. Stormwind Nougat is an Alliance-exclusive holiday treat offered by the human capital's innkeeper for the Alliance quest line involving Jesper.

angles.text: Stormwind Nougat is one of four civic confections that showcase the shared festive spirit among the allied capitals during Hallow's End.
For humans of Stormwind, sharing nougat and entertaining orphaned children like Jesper keeps community spirits high in the rebuilt capital.
